 H=len(g); W=len(g[0]); p={i:[x for x in row if x][0] for i,row in enumerate(g) if any(row)}; s=sorted(p); z=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]

  elif i==H-1: z[i]=[p[s[-1]]]*W
  elif i in p: z[i]=[p[i]]*W
  else:
   a=[q for q in s if q<i]; b=[q for q in s if q>i]
   if not a: c=p[s[0]]

   else: c=p[b[0]] if b[0]-a[-1]>2 and i==b[0]-1 else p[a[-1]]
   z[i][0]=c; z[i][-1]=c
 return z"}
